svg.title: An independent label creates synergy and negative unique information
svg.desc: A source independent of the other source and the target gets equal redundancy and synergy and an opposite unique atom; the closed form follows from the OR event mixing evidence with label noise.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: AN INDEPENDENT LABEL CREATES SYNERGY AND NEGATIVE UNIQUE INFORMATION
(a) Why it happens: the OR event mixes evidence with label noise
label C (independent of R, T)
R = r, C ≠ c: evidence ratio ρ = p(t|r)/p(t), share w
C = c: ratio 1 (the label says nothing), share 1 − w
P(t | R = r or C = c) / p(t) = w ρ + (1 − w), w = pr(1 − qc) / (pr(1 − qc) + qc)
Since i({2}) = 0 and i({12}) = i({1}), Möbius inversion gives Red = Syn = −UnqC = log(wρ + 1 − w) at every row.
(b) Refining the label raises Red = Syn towards I(R; T)
label values m (uniform label)
T = (A, B), R = A
spiking unit, no context synapse
drone: R = V, T = V ∧ R′
Dots: exact MGW atoms. At m = 2 the spiking
dot is the simulated unit's own value, 0.1587.
(c) The sandwich w·KL ≤ Red ≤ w·χ2 (drone law)
common weight w
w · χ2(pT|r ‖ pT)
Red
w · D(pT|r ‖ pT)
A fair label gives w = 1/3; at w = 1, Red = I(V; T).
(d) How fast UnqR vanishes: two rates
label values m
drone: UnqR ≈ (1/4)/m
full support: no first-order term, UnqR ∝ 1/m2​
The rate law
UnqR = κ Σr [1 − PT(supp pT|r)] + O(κ max qc),
with κ = Σc qc2, the label's collision
probability (1/m for a uniform label).
If every pT|r has full support the first-
order term is zero and the decay is quadratic.
Other PIDs disagree
Under BROJA and Imin the label has
zero redundancy, unique information
and synergy for every m.
Closed forms checked against exact MGW atoms on four laws, one of them from a simulated spiking neuron.
